questions.question: In DC generator, the emf induced in the armature is
questions.explanation: The source explains commutator rectifies generated emf. So emf induced in armature is alternating before commutation.

questions.question: The role of commutators in DC machine is to convert
questions.explanation: The commutator acts as a mechanical rectifier in DC machine. It converts armature AC into DC at the terminals.
explanationLines: The commutator acts as a mechanical rectifier in DC machine.
It converts armature AC into DC at the terminals.

questions.question: The core of DC machine is made up of

explanationLines: The source uses laminated silicon steel for machine cores.
This helps reduce core losses.

questions.question: The field winding of a DC machine are usually made up of

explanationLines: Field winding carries current, so copper is used.
The source lists copper for winding material.

questions.question: The armature resistance of DC machine is generally of the range

questions.question: A thick wire is used in dc series motor field winding than that in dc shunt motor
questions.explanation: Series field carries armature current, so it must carry heavy current. Thick wire also keeps resistance low.
explanationLines: Series field carries armature current, so it must carry heavy current.
Thick wire also keeps resistance low.

questions.question: Which component of DC machine is also known as mechanical rectifier?
questions.explanation: The commutator mechanically changes AC in armature to DC output. That is why it is called a mechanical rectifier.
explanationLines: The commutator mechanically changes AC in armature to DC output.
That is why it is called a mechanical rectifier.

questions.question: What is a DC machine?
options: Rotating electrical machine used as motor or generator
questions.correctOption: Rotating electrical machine used as motor or generator

explanationLines: The source defines DC machines as rotating electrical machines.
They can work as motors or generators.

questions.question: When a DC machine acts as generator, it converts ............
questions.explanation: The source states generator converts mechanical energy to electrical energy. A DC generator is also known as a dynamo.
explanationLines: The source states generator converts mechanical energy to electrical energy.
A DC generator is also known as a dynamo.

questions.question: When a DC machine acts as motor, it converts ............
questions.explanation: The source says DC motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. It produces rotational motion or torque.
explanationLines: The source says DC motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
It produces rotational motion or torque.

questions.question: The two main types of DC machines are ............
questions.explanation: The source gives two types of DC machines. They are DC generator and DC motor.
explanationLines: The source gives two types of DC machines.
They are DC generator and DC motor.

questions.question: DC generator works on which principle?
questions.explanation: The source says DC generator works on Faraday's law. Rotating armature in magnetic field induces emf.
explanationLines: The source says DC generator works on Faraday's law.
Rotating armature in magnetic field induces emf.

questions.question: What produces torque in a DC motor?
options: Interaction of field pole magnetic field and armature current
questions.correctOption: Interaction of field pole magnetic field and armature current
questions.explanation: The source says torque comes from interaction of magnetic field and current. This produces rotational motion in the motor.
explanationLines: The source says torque comes from interaction of magnetic field and current.
This produces rotational motion in the motor.

questions.question: Which part of DC machine protects the inner parts?
questions.explanation: The source describes yoke as the outer frame of DC machine. It protects and supports inner parts.
explanationLines: The source describes yoke as the outer frame of DC machine.
It protects and supports inner parts.

questions.question: Which part carries field winding in a DC machine?
questions.explanation: Field poles carry field coils in DC machine. They produce the main magnetic flux.

They produce the main magnetic flux.

questions.question: Which winding is placed on the armature core?

Emf is induced in the armature winding.

questions.question: What is the function of carbon brush?
questions.explanation: Brushes make sliding contact with the commutator. They connect rotating armature circuit to external circuit.
explanationLines: Brushes make sliding contact with the commutator.
They connect rotating armature circuit to external circuit.

questions.question: Why is armature core laminated?
questions.explanation: The source uses laminated core construction. Lamination reduces eddy current loss in the core.
explanationLines: The source uses laminated core construction.
Lamination reduces eddy current loss in the core.

questions.question: In a DC generator, what rotates inside the magnetic field?
questions.explanation: The source says armature is rotated by external source. Emf is induced in it due to magnetic field.
explanationLines: The source says armature is rotated by external source.
Emf is induced in it due to magnetic field.

questions.question: What is another name of DC generator in the source?

questions.question: DC generator emf increases when speed ............

Higher speed cuts flux faster and gives more emf.

questions.question: Which is a type of DC generator by excitation?

questions.question: Back emf in DC motor acts against ............

questions.question: Why is a DC motor starter needed?

So a starter is needed to limit armature current.

questions.question: At starting, the back emf of a DC motor is ............

This makes starting current high without starter.
